evidence: To investigate the composition of putative midgut secretions from larvae of L. noctiluca, we established a reliable extraction procedure.
In the current study, we provide a first compositional analysis of the midgut secretion from lampyrid larvae, with a focus on identifying putative neurotoxins causing the observed paralyzing effect.
Last-stage larval specimens of L. noctiluca were manually collected in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany (50°57′ N 6°52′ E).

selected value: Q Exactive Plus, Bruker ultrafleXtreme TOF/TOF
judge corrected value: Q Exactive Plus, Bruker ultrafleXtreme TOF/TOF
